title: shell has ended talks with unimot over selling german refinery stake bloomberg 2026 08 27
text:
Aug 27 (Reuters) - British oil major Shell (SHEL.L)
, opens new tab
 has ended ​negotiations to sell its stake in Germany's ‌Russia-linked Schwedt refinery to Polish energy group Unimot (UNTP.WA)
, opens new tab
, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people ​familiar with the matter
